revisions.note: 集石 wiki version of the ability (page updated 2026-07); English is our translation.

en.name: Gudiao
en.ability: Each night, you learn the character of the next alive Townsfolk clockwise: they are poisoned & might register as an evil Gudiao until dusk. Once per game, at night, you may change direction.

revisions.v1: Each night, choose left or right: you learn the character of next alive good player in that direction, they are poisoned and register as evil Gudiao until dusk.
revisions.v2026-07: Each night, you learn the character of the next alive Townsfolk clockwise: they are poisoned & might register as an evil Gudiao until dusk. Once per game, at night, you may change direction.

zh.name: 蛊雕
zh.ability: 每个夜晚，你会得知顺时针方向上的下一名存活的镇民玩家的角色，他中毒且可能被当作邪恶的蛊雕，直到下个黄昏。每局游戏限一次，在夜晚时，你可以改变方向。

revisions.v1: 每个夜晚，你要选择左或右：你得知该方向上的下一名存活善良玩家的角色，他中毒且其他善良玩家以为他是邪恶的蛊雕，直到下个黄昏。
revisions.v2026-07: 每个夜晚，你会得知顺时针方向上的下一名存活的镇民玩家的角色，他中毒且可能被当作邪恶的蛊雕，直到下个黄昏。每局游戏限一次，在夜晚时，你可以改变方向。
